steps.en: The officer opens the search page for furnished hirers and drivers
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman pencarian hirer dan driver yang difurnish

steps.en: Officers can search by notice, vehicle and ID number
steps.id: Officer dapat mencari berdasarkan notice, kendaraan, dan nomor ID

steps.en: Officers can search by a range of submission dates
steps.id: Officer dapat mencari berdasarkan rentang tanggal submission

steps.en: Officers can filter requests by status
steps.id: Officer dapat memfilter permintaan berdasarkan status

steps.en: Matching notices are listed on screen to browse
steps.id: Notice yang cocok ditampilkan di layar untuk ditelusuri
